verdict.rationale: Shopify documents public UCP MCP (JSON-RPC) endpoints for the whole agent journey (catalog search, cart, checkout and order state) plus a CLI and an openly published UCP spec. Runtime probes confirm live handshakes and a real cart created through the protocol. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/llms.txt at shopify.dev (all candidate paths 404), and order webhook subscription is not self-serve via API (requires contacting a partner manager), with Order MCP gated to Token-tier agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Connect any AI assistant to real-time commerce data from Shopify stores with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
the CLI provides structured commands to search the Catalog, build carts, create checkouts, hand off buyers, and track orders
The Checkout MCP server enables AI agents to create and manage checkout sessions, convert carts into checkouts, and refer buyers to the merchant storefront to complete purchases.
The Order MCP server enables AI agents to fetch the current state of an order placed through their agent, including line items, fulfillment events, and post-purchase adjustments.
Shopify's Global Catalog MCP server is live — a keyless JSON-RPC initialize POST to https://catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp completed a FULL handshake
a REAL cart was created keylessly on Shopify's own hardware store through the UCP protocol
the Universal Commerce Protocol spec is published in the open
